items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: A young lady who was a friend of my wife brought her and made me acquainted

ctx.x: Ella Latimore. A young lady who was a friend of my wife brought her and made me acquainted, and my wife, as I told you, attended Tuskegee Institute. My wife also did, but that was after my day, but Ella brought her around and I don't know what it was, but it just looked like something that impressed me and I don't know (inaudible), and
I said, my goodness, I've got to find out about this lady.
